dogecoin.text: The media coverage of #dogecoin is so embarrassing. It didn't drop because @elonmusk called it a hustle. It dropped bc a whale dumped over a billion coins, a move which had been planned for weeks. The doge community is down a few whales today, which is a good thing #dogetothemoon
